why: Re-check of the 157 Canadian private parks from the 2026-10-07/08 private gap (ids 14938-15125), admitted on an RV Life / Google screen plus a probe that the operator site loaded. That probe let through a sold-and-closed park, a dead domain, a seasonal-only resort and a tent-only area (dropped 2026-10-11). Each park's own pages were read for closure, seasonal-only, tent-only and minimum-stay wording (scan.py, then bscan.py in a browser for pages plain urllib could not read); no-website entries were checked against their Google listing.
